messages:
Sam: FYI p99 for /v1/chat popped from ~220ms -> ~780ms at 09:13 UTC. Dashboard shows the spike but the endpoint breakdown looks contradictory (one route shows no change).

Priya: I think this is another sample-origin issue. When we do split routing (canary + stable) we sometimes record only the route label, not an adjusted sample_count, so rollups treat each route equally. That distorts p-values.

Lin: can you share the exact dashboard query? cheaper to reproduce than guess.

Sam: console query:
```sql
SELECT tdigest_percentile(tdigest_merge(histogram_td), [0.5,0.95,0.99])
FROM metric_histograms
WHERE endpoint = '/v1/chat' AND window='5m'
```
We are merging per-route tdigests emitted by the routers.

Marco: merging unweighted tdigests will misrepresent when route A served 90% of traffic but route B (fast) accounted for most emitted tdigest summaries. We need provenance: which route contributed how many raw samples near the cutpoint.

Priya: proposal: add a small column to the endpoint table "quantile_provenance" that lists top-3 contributing routes for each quantile with sample counts. UI would surface it on hover for p50/p95/p99.

Lin: nice. For implementation, backend should expose an API: `/internal/metrics/quantile_provenance?endpoint=/v1/chat&quantiles=0.95,0.99&window=5m&top=3`. It would return a list of routes + count-of-samples-in-band (as strings).

Sam: acceptable short-term. For correctness we also need emitters to include `bucket_sample_count` in histogram payloads when routing fractions are not 1.0. That avoids inventing weights during merge.

Marco: follow-up engineering note: standard tdigest doesn't support sample weights cleanly. We can either switch to weighted-centroid tdigest variant or convert histograms to explicit bucketed counts and merge those. Both affect storage/ingest cost.

Priya: UX asks: - show p50/p95/p99 provenance inline; - add a small banner when route weights are non-uniform: "Percentiles may be unweighted"; - add a console toggle to compute using weighted-merge (canary).

Lin: I'll add a canary flag `metrics.weighted_percentile` behind feature flags and wire the API to use weighted merge when enabled. Will also emit a console note when disabled.

Sam: runbook addition: when changing routing weights, enable weighted_percentile canary and keep it for 24-72h; emit detailed provenance for troubleshooting.

Marco: I'll prototype the backend endpoint that computes contributors by scanning raw histograms for samples within +/-5% of quantile cutpoint and summing per-route counts. Endpoint will be read-only and rate-limited.

metrics-bot: Ticket created: MR-5580 - "quantile provenance API + console UX" assigned to Lin. Priority: P2. Link: https://redwood.example/infra/MR-5580

Priya: tiny ask: add pctl delta column (current vs previous window) so people don't overreact to short blips. Coloring rules: >25% increase = orange, >100% = red.

Sam: good call. Also add a note on the chart explaining "Sample origin: router labels may not reflect emitted sample counts".

Lin: will start on the API prototype today, pinging @eng-sre for validation once MR-5580 is up.
